title: icSHAPE
scope: Spitale 2015 icSHAPE implementation, with registered protocol PMID26766114 for supported clarification. Extraction covers the in vivo NAI-N3-modified RNA route depicted in the assigned strip and the icSHAPE row of the RNA Structure poster, ending in eluted first-strand cDNA. The descriptive hairpins identify the assay and do not add reactions; the paired RNA cartoons show examples within one preparation, without a split or pooling step. The neighbouring SHAPE-Seq and CIRS-seq rows, mock-treatment controls, ex vivo adaptations, subsequent cDNA library completion and sequencing are outside the depicted route. Total versus poly(A)-selected RNA is not specified by the drawing; both are supported starting preparations in the 2015 paper.
